decision.most_plausible_family_from_bound: 8x gate + 8x up/down or asymmetric 8x on the dominant side; 4x/4x has too little overhead margin.
decision.next_source_edit_allowed_if: Implement a default-off resident/batched microprobe only after selecting a family with passes_design_gate=true and defining exact tensor/row layout plus top1 verifier plan.
decision.reason: Need a concrete resident/partial representation with >=6 tok/s zero-overhead bound and a kernel design whose overhead budget remains positive. Current per-call Q80 is correctness-only.

interpretation.what_q80_does_not_prove: It does not prove any 4x/8x compressed weight representation is numerically safe; low-bit/partial representation still needs its own top1 gate.
interpretation.what_q80_proves: Current Q8_0 CPU-compatible path proves MXFP4 weights x Q8_0 activations can be token-stable for fixed text when it replaces CPU fallback.
interpretation.why_per_call_not_perf: Per-call path copies about 1.079 GiB src0 per token and spends 211.5 ms/token in kernel_sync, so it is much slower than target.

prompt_scope: calibration/dev bounds plus fixed France correctness profile; held-out unused
